status: Locally declared before executing matching; no external preregistration or claim of historical blinding
scope: Outcome-free geometry, overlap and block-dependence checks only; no observed magnetic values, contrasts or p-values
grid_rule: Use native atlas covariates. A 0.5 degree mask illustrates geometry only; never count its samples as independent evidence.

northern_cell_reproduction.definition: Same validity mask, epoch rank == 1 and north-of-boundary Curve2Mask classification as six-test builder

eligibility.boundary_side: south for both Arabia and controls
eligibility.treatment: Eligible cells inside the saved Arabia footprint
eligibility.control: Eligible cells outside that footprint and at least 300 km from its edge

matching.algorithm: Maximum-cardinality minimum squared scaled-distance bipartite assignment; dummy penalty exceeds the maximum sum of valid edge costs; deterministic input ordering
matching.role: Covariate overlap only. Calipers and densities are declared sensitivities, not independent replications.

blocks.construction: Latitude bands of size/R radians; longitude sectors approximating the declared width at each band midpoint. These are nominal, not exact equal-area square blocks.
blocks.randomization_unit_candidate: Connected components of the graph whose vertices are occupied spatial blocks and edges are matched pairs; never flip pairs sharing a block independently
blocks.screen_role: Declared feasibility screens, not a theorem of independence or exchangeability. Close components require further joint modelling.

decision_gates.balance_rule: Matched area-weighted mean difference divided by pooled unmatched SD; retain the denominator across matching
decision_gates.pass_meaning: Only a necessary feasibility screen. Statistical exchangeability and null calibration remain unproven.
decision_gates.failure_meaning: No observed-field significance test. Preserve failed masks and matched sets; do not relax after seeing magnetic outcomes.

null_calibration: Pending a supported block design. If geometry and overlap fail, do not present a permutation p-value; no observed outcome is needed to detect this failure.
prior_context: Global magnetic associations and the six-test results were already known. The claim is procedural non-use of magnetic values for these masks and matches, not a blind discovery.
